content:
Clearbit is a real-time B2B data enrichment and marketing intelligence platform. It is designed to transform fragmented lead data into fully enriched business profiles. The platform is integrated into HubSpot as Breeze Intelligence. Overall, Clearbit is an expert in real-time data enrichment, lead routing, website visitor identification, form shortening, and technographic intelligence.

How does Clearbit work?

Clearbit works using a real-time enrichment engine. It continuously gathers, validates, standardizes, and gives business intelligence data. The process includes three main stages:

  1. Step-by-Step workflow- Clearbit starts its enrichment process with a trigger. It could be a user giving a work email, a lead entering CRM, a visitor landing on the website, or an IP address hitting a tracking script.
  2. Matching and Data Processing - Clearbit parses email addresses, company domains, IP addresses, and browser signals. Next, it compares it against the live master database from public registries, legal filings, job boards, or corporate websites. 
  3. Data Delivery- Clearbit also appends company size, revenue estimates, employee count, job seniority, social links, and more. It is directly put into CRMs, analytics tools, workflows, and APIs.

Core Capabilities

Real-Time Contact and Company Enrichment

Clearbit appends more than 100 firmographic, demographic, and technographic attributes to incoming leads.

Form Shortening and Smart Forms

It reduces long forms into simple email-only forms. In turn, Clearbit enriches hidden CRM fields in the background.

Website Visitor Reveal

The platform uses reverse IP intelligence to identify anonymous companies visiting your website.

Lead Routing and Scoring

Clearbit automatically qualifies and routes leads based on the Ideal Customer Profile. 

Database Cleansing and Hygiene

It consistently refreshes CRM records when leads change jobs, companies grow, or the domain becomes inactive.

What makes Clearbit stand out?

  • API-First Infrastructure- Clearbit was made as a developer-first enrichment platform with sub-200ms response time. 
  • Native HubSpot Integration- Clearbit works as a deeply embedded data layer inside HubSpot. It requires no external connectors, offers native workflow automation, and simplifies security reviews. 
  • Real-Time Form Optimization- The platform hides unnecessary fields, enriches data behind the scenes, and improves conversion rates.
  • Strong Data Normalization- Clearbit automatically standardizes messy job titles, country formats, industries, and seniority levels. 
  • Deep Technographic Tracking- It finds installed software stacks, tracking scripts, hosting providers, and more

Key Services

  • Real-Time Enrichment: Clearbit transforms work email addresses or domains into complete B2B profiles immediately.
  • Smart Forms-It improves inbound conversion rates by dynamically shortening signup forms.
  • Website Reveal- The platform identifies anonymous companies browsing for pricing, documentation, integrations, and demos.
  • Audience Building- Clearbit makes hyper-targeted audience segments using company size, technology users, employee count, and more.

Advanced Capabilities

  • Advanced Technographic Monitoring- Clearbit tracks niche software installations and infrastructure changes in different companies.
  • Multi-Identifier De-Anonymization- It combines IP addresses, browser cookies, login history, and VPN endpoints to enhance anonymous visitor identification. 
  • Enterprise Data Governance- The platform allows RevOps teams to create overwrite rules, enforce data hygiene, normalize CRM fields, and more. 
  • Dynamic In-app personalization- Clearbit allows developers to personalize pricing pages, onboarding flows, and product experiences based on real-time company intelligence.

Who should work with Clearbit?

  • High Volume Inbound marketing teams aiming to increase conversions for free trials, webinar signups, etc.
  • Product-led growth SaaS Companies who want to find enterprise accounts and focus on outbound follow-up. 
  • Revenue Operations Teams are looking for CRM cleansing and lifecycle management. 
  • Account-Based Marketing teams intending to target accounts visiting the websites

Best Fit Industries

  • SaaS and Cloud Technology 
  • Professional Services 
  • E-commerce Infrastructure 
  • Commercial Real Estate 

Key Use Cases

  • Form Conversion Optimization: Clearbit reduces long-form upsells to single-field submissions. Still, it gathers data on company size, industry, seniority, and location, etc.
  • Intent-based outbound prospecting- It enables sales teams to get alerts when high-value companies visit pricing pages and browse documentation.
  • Instant Lead Routing- The platform automatically routes enterprise accounts to senior AEs. At the same time, it routes SMB accounts to nurture flows. 
  • Database Hygiene and Maintenance- Clearbit automatically updates job changes, fixes dead domains, refreshes company growth data, and standardizes CRM inputs.

Pros 

  • Reliable Data Standardization 
  • Quick real-time enrichment 
  • Native HubSpot Ecosystem Integration 
  • Excellent form shortening 
  • Strong Technographic Intelligence

Considerations 

  • Not ideal for SDR dependent on cold calling 
  • Comparatively weaker coverage in Europe, LATAM, Asia-Pacific 
  • Strictly B2B Focused
  • Vulnerable in Offline Industries
  • Credit Consumption can scale quickly

Top Alternatives

  • MarketJoy- Specializes in multi-channel B2B lead generation services
  • ZoomInfo- Exceptional enterprise sales intelligence and direct-dial phone data
  • Apollo.io- Impressive and affordable outbound prospecting 
  • Cognism- Exceptional GDPR-compliant European prospecting 
  • Lusha- Ideal lightweight LinkedIn prospecting

Conclusion

Clearbit is one of the most advanced real-time B2B enrichment platforms. It is specially meant for companies operating digital-first go-to-market strategies. The platform specializes in real-time enrichment, HubSpot integration, inbound optimization, RevOps automation, etc. Want to convert your anonymous traffic and fragmented CRM records into actionable revenue? Clearbit's powerful intelligence is just what you need to scale and grow.
